QuestInfo.name: An Ominous Feeling
QuestInfo.0: You've found a part of the Core Fragment, but it seems too small to be of any real help. What should you do now? And who are the people that stole the Core from you in the first place?
QuestInfo.1: You've found a part of the Core Fragment, but it seems too small to be of any real help. What should you do now? And who are the people that stole the Core from you in the first place? It might be a good time to update Kyrin on what you've found out.
QuestInfo.2: You found a part of the Core Fragment, but it seemed too small to be of any real help. You pondered what to do next, mulling over who it might be that stole the Core from you in the first place. When you updated Kyrin on the situation, she said she had an ominous feeling about all of this. She vowed that she'll never forgive those who dared to steal her property, promising you that she'll get them back for this, no matter what.
